risk_if_not_implemented: Without Quantum-Safe Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Transition, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to securely implement an internal Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) infrastructure or obtain PKI services from a reputable PKI service provider.
compensating_control_1.justification: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) (CRY-09) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Quantum-Safe Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Transition (QTS-09.7) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cryptographic Key Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cryptographic Key Management (CRY-10) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Quantum-Safe Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Transition (QTS-09.7) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
